A New Farming Way

一种新的耕作方法 · 184 词 · 3 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1Tuan was a farmer in Vietnam. For decades, he had been struggling to rid his family of hunger. However, he could never work out how to expand his crop output. This disturbing problem made him regret becoming a farmer. He would rather have chosen another job.

2One day, when skimming through a newspaper, Tuan read a comment on Yuan Longping. He underlined Yuan’s nationality and occupation, and then focused on his discovery and the statistics from his research. He found the information Yuan circulated very practical. Therefore, he made a summary and began to develop a new farming method. He planted a nutritious variety of grain and equipped himself with the knowledge needed to protect the roots of his crops from harmful bacteria and pests. He also increased the mineral content of the soil while using less chemical fertiliser. Though it cost him more time and freedom, he was full of hope.

3The next year, Tuan was sunburnt but very satisfied with his harvest. Thanks to Yuan Longping, he had won the battle against hunger and could even export his crops to buyers abroad.

一种新的耕作方法

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1俊是越南的一名农民。几十年来，他一直在为让家人吃饱而努力。可怎样提高庄稼的产量，他总是想不明白。这个让人头疼的问题让他后悔当了农民，宁愿当初选了别的工作。

2一天，俊浏览报纸时看到一篇评论袁隆平的文章。他在袁隆平的国籍和职业下画了线，接着仔细看他的发现和研究数据。袁隆平传播的知识很实用，俊就把要点归纳下来，着手摸索新的耕作方法。他种下营养丰富的优良谷物，学着保护庄稼的根部，使其免受细菌和害虫侵害。他还设法增加土壤里的矿物质，同时减少化肥用量。这样做多花了时间，也少了些自由，可他满怀希望。

3第二年，俊虽然晒伤了，却对收成十分满意。多亏袁隆平，他终于让家人摆脱了饥饿，甚至可以把农作物出口到国外。
